commands.result: All six groups pass independently, including new first-label/value-cycle tests and valid self-pointer/self-slice controls.

Eight independent target modes: old invalid block/direct cycle rejected; mixed struct/zero-array cycle rejected; valid 8000-deep forward type chain accepted without host or target recursion failure. Newly added legal aggregate-to-field OFFSET projection is incorrectly rejected.

resolved_findings: M1-first-block-contract: missing/non-1 entry LABEL rejected as I_INTERNAL, without ELF.
M1-recursive-value-layout: direct/mutual/mixed value cycles rejected; pointer/slice indirection remains valid.

findings.problem: Opcode 7 calls same(dst,a), requiring identical pointer pointee TypeId. H3 explicitly permits internal layout projections, so legal *[2]u32 plus 4-byte offset to *u32 is rejected as I_INTERNAL. Independent target probe confirms no ELF is generated; this also prevents F slice.len projection from integrating.
findings.required_change: Permit already-typed internal OFFSET projection to a different pointee while requiring pointer operands, usize offset and preserved access permissions. Keep source-level pointer cast legality owned by F; add positive projection and negative const-permission/nonpointer operand tests.

verified_contracts: M1 two blockers are resolved without weakening author tests or valid ABI/image/assembler behavior.
Type-cycle algorithm uses explicit bounded storage and accepted an independent 8000-deep chain.
M2 adds 73737 bytes of DFS state; final I resource accounting must include this measured-layout addition.
limitations: M2 remains not accepted because legal typed projection is required for integration. No product files changed by reviewer.
